svg.title: ARC vocabulary map — detailed
svg.desc: Detailed visual glossary of ARC naming conventions with examples, notation, and edge cases.
svg.text: Domain (puzzle) vocabulary for the ARC-1 work. Examples left · notation & edge-cases right. Kept separate from MindsOS substrate terms.
demonstration pairs — one rule; sizes may differ
• grids may differ in size across pairs
• a task can have more than one test input
the array, one square, and its coordinate
grid[r][c] = color at row r, col c

text.tspan: full H×W array; every cell colored

svg.text: fixed symbols; background is derived, not assumed 0

text.tspan: one of 10 symbols 0–9; a label, not a quantity
the set of colors present in a grid

svg.text: • not hardcoded to 0; often 0 but not always
• input and output backgrounds may differ
all non-background cells (vs the full grid)
• the rule usually transforms the figure,

text.tspan: object normalized: moved to origin, color dropped

svg.text: object properties: cells · area · bbox · color(s) · position

text.tspan: sharing an edge OR a corner (+ diagonals)

svg.text: • choice changes object count AND boundaries
• fix per operation — it is a parameter,
• separate choice: group same-color only, or
a set of cells, its box, its footprint

text.tspan: any set of cells (need not connect)

svg.text: • holes = bbox cells not in the region
• translate = add a vector to every cell

text.tspan: shared row or column (Δr=0 or Δc=0)
one region inside another's bbox / enclosed
regions share one or more cells

svg.text: seed primitives — the DSL verbs (menu, not frozen)
the seed primitives (a starting menu — NOT frozen):

text.tspan: translate · rotate · reflect · scale/tile · crop · pad

svg.text: • a composite is a named sequence of these,
minted only if it pays for its complexity (MDL)
the hypothesis, its test, and honest don't-know
a structural verdict, not a low-confidence guess

text.tspan: a measured property used in a condition
no consistent rule found within budget

svg.text: • consistent ≠ correct — few demos can be overfit
• generalization = also correct on the held-out query
• abstaining on the unsolved ones is the honest win
